title: Fans Choose LISA’s ‘Press Play’ as This Week’s Favorite New Music
summary: The BLACKPINK singer's latest solo release brought in 87% of the vote.
contentText:
Press Play , the new solo EP from LISA of BLACKPINK, tops this week’s new music poll.

Related

LISA, Miley, Kacey Musgraves & John Mayer: New Music Friday Guide

Listeners voted in a poll published Friday (Oct. 23) on Billboard , choosing LISA’s EP as their favorite new music.

The six-song solo collection topped new releases from Hilary Duff, John Mayer, ATEEZ, Miley Cyrus and more based on reader votes, closing down the poll at an overwhelming 87%.

Press Play arrived on Friday (Oct. 23) along with a music video for the track “Tarantino,” following the pre-release single “SaWaDiKa” that dropped last month. LISA has a songwriting credit on all six tracks.

The set’s title comes from a “Tarantino” lyric: “It’s a movie baby, come and press play.”

“Got my nails really long like the barrel of my gun,” she sings on the chorus. “And my lipstick all over your face/ I’m a boss, I’m a don when I’m drivin’ to the sun/ It’s a movie, baby, come and press play/ Tarantino, Tarantino/ Got my feet hangin’ out the Camino/ Tarantino, Tarantino/ Got my feet hangin’ out the Camino.”

The Thai artist has a mini Las Vegas residency coming up, with show dates on Nov. 12-14 and Nov. 27-29.

Trailing behind Press Play on Billboard ‘s poll are Hilary Duff’s Holiday Things, John Mayer’s “Tom and Jerry,” ATEEZ’s “Drop” and Miley Cyrus’ “Cold Blooded.”
